products.reason_for_recall: World Organic Corporation dba Licata Enterprise is recalling multiple vitamins because it contains fish liver oil that is declared on the product label; however, the label also states "Contains NO...common allergens." The product also contains the following dietary ingredients that are missing from the label: molybdenum, pancreatin, diastase, papain, ox bile, vanadium, silicon, boron and bromelain.
